educationalGoal: You will learn about the culture and society of Korea, a neighboring country closely related to Japan. It can raise and enhance interest in Korean culture and society, and ultimately cultivate intercultural communication skills. ・Traditional culture ・Popular culture ・Life culture ・Leisure culture
advice: -Understand Korean and Korean culture collectively. -Based on this, we will provide opportunities for communication between cultures by accepting and understanding multiculturalism, and ultimately seek the path of coexistence and co-prosperity in which humanity lives together. -Comprehend traditional culture such as clothing, food and shelter, popular culture represented by K-POP, Leisure culture centered on play, sightseeing, lifestyle, etc. Can be cultivated.
